item.title: PostgreSQL Query Parsing Too Slow? PgDog Ditched Protobuf and Got 5x Faster
item.description: PgDog is a Rust-based PostgreSQL proxy. They discovered Protobuf serialization was the real bottleneck in SQL query parsing — not the Postgres parser itself. By replacing Protobuf with direct C-to-Rust FFI bindings, they achieved 5-10x faster parsing.
